description: Intro_ASM supplies R and Shiny teaching applications for dynamic mass balances in activated-sludge wastewater treatment. They can run offline or on a Shiny server. This resource is provided by Markus Ahnert. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: GPL-3.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The linked demonstration website is explicitly experimental and subject to change. Teaching reuse is intended but not independently demonstrated here. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
